recordings.text: The group chat has a birthday coming up. Bring everyone into one card. Add a message, make it personal, and open a surprise full of familiar voices. Hooray. Make a card together.
A goodbye deserves more than a thumbs-up. Give the whole team a place to leave a message. Kind words, little memories, one thoughtful card. Make it a Hooray moment.
That tiny rocket is yours. Fly out, find a world, and make the landing. Then step outside and see what is there. Sundust. Your next little space adventure starts here.
One landing can start a whole adventure. Explore the surface, gather resources, and decide what comes next. Stay a little longer. There is a universe to discover in Sundust.
I know exactly what to get them. Save that thought in Giftly, with the person it belongs to. Keep their birthday and their little details nearby. A thoughtful gift starts with an idea.
The birthday is next week. Open Giftly, see what is coming up, and find the ideas you saved. Their tastes, sizes, and past gifts are all together. Less last-minute. More thoughtful.
How many repositories are open in your head? Ground Control brings your Git fleet into view. See branches, local changes, and what needs attention. A little more context before your next move.
Before the next pull, take a look. Follow the branch history, review local changes, and stay oriented across your repositories. Ground Control. Mission control for Git on your Mac.

You have the notes. Now make them practice. Brainfold turns study material into flashcards and quizzes. Review one question at a time, and come back with spaced repetition. Start with what you are studying.
Stuck on a concept? Ask Brainfold's AI tutor about your material, then return to a question and try it yourself. Notes, practice, and help in one study routine. Keep the next step small.
Your camera roll is already telling a story. Memories brings the moments into a personal timeline and turns your months into films. Mark the little things you want to keep. Life moves. Keep a little.
Start with the date that matters to you. A baby's first year, your anniversary, or a year in your own life. Follow the months and save the highlights. Make room to look back with Memories.

The next project needs some room. Poof shows caches, large files, and development leftovers on your Mac. Review what is there and choose what goes. A little less mystery. A little more breathing space.
Before you clean, look at the list. Poof puts storage clutter in view so you can review the selection first. Choose what to remove, then make room for what is next.
The trip is not today. The excitement is. Soooon counts down to your big days with a little companion that gets excited with you. Birthdays, trips, and celebrations. Good things are getting closer.
What are you looking forward to? Add the date, pick your kind of hype, and make the wait part of the fun. Soooon. A little companion for the days until your big day.
Another renewal? Check what is next. My Renewals brings your subscriptions, recurring costs, and upcoming dates together. See the total and review each plan. Go into next month with a clearer view.
Small monthly payments add up. Keep the plans in one place, look at your recurring total, and see what renews next. My Renewals. A little more clarity before the next charge.
You were deep in work. Your meeting is coming up. Toc Toc gets your attention with a knock and a visible countdown, with a way into your call. Deep in work? Toc toc.
The calendar alert was easy to miss. Give your next meeting a reminder you can see. Check your agenda from the menu bar and keep the countdown in view. Meet Toc Toc.
When was the last feed? Start with a shared view of the day. Zuzu keeps sleep, feeding, and diaper changes together so everyone caring for your baby can follow along. One little day, together.

A day with a baby has a lot of little details. Follow the timeline, check the everyday events, and keep the care records together. Zuzu helps you see what happened, without holding every detail in your head.
